findings.issue: No frontend-to-API trace ID propagation â€” browser does not send x-request-id header
findings.impact: Cannot correlate frontend errors with API request logs; debugging client-side issues requires manual log digging
findings.fix: Add request ID generation to Next.js middleware or BFF route handler, propagate x-request-id header on all API calls

findings.issue: No automated alerting configured for any failure mode
findings.impact: Operators rely on manual health check polling; no push notifications for degraded DB, worker failure, or API down
findings.fix: Configure Sentry alert rules for error thresholds, add uptime monitoring with PagerDuty/webhook integration, add DO monitoring alerts for CPU/memory/disk

findings.issue: No structured error taxonomy or error codes â€” errors are strings not grouped by category
findings.impact: Cannot easily aggregate or alert on specific error types across services
findings.fix: Define AppError codes enum (AUTH_xxx, VALIDATION_xxx, DB_xxx, RATE_xxx) and enforce in all route handlers and services

findings.issue: Prometheus metrics endpoint exists but no metrics export from worker service
findings.impact: Worker health and throughput not visible in monitoring dashboards
findings.fix: Expose /metrics endpoint in worker HTTP server with BullMQ queue stats and job counters

findings.issue: No incident response runbook covering worker failure, API crash, or database degradation scenarios
findings.impact: Operators lack documented playbooks for common failure modes, increasing MTTR
findings.fix: Create incident response runbook covering: worker crash recovery, API restart procedure, DB connection pool exhaustion, Redis failure fallback
